result.instructions: Tools for Modern Treasury, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which payment orders are still pending, and who are they for?"; "Show me the latest bank transactions on my internal accounts."; "Which payments were returned recently, and why?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Modern Treasury data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run modern_treasury_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run modern_treasury_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run modern_treasury_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. modern_treasury_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Modern Treasury
prompts.description: What you can do with Modern Treasury here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: check_payment_orders_and_expected_payments
prompts.title: Check payment orders and expected payments
prompts.description: The AI lists payment orders and reads one by id. It also lists expected payments. You see what is still pending and who it is for. This reads only and approves nothing.

prompts.name: review_bank_transactions_on_your_internal_accounts
prompts.title: Review bank transactions on your internal accounts
prompts.description: The AI lists your internal bank accounts and the bank transactions, and reads one transaction by id. It sums up what came in and went out.

prompts.name: see_which_payments_were_returned
prompts.title: See which payments were returned
prompts.description: The AI lists payment returns, such as ACH returns, so you can see what failed and look into each one.

prompts.name: look_up_counterparties_and_their_bank_accounts
prompts.title: Look up counterparties and their bank accounts
prompts.description: The AI lists counterparties and their external bank accounts, and reads one counterparty by id. You see who you pay or get paid by.

prompts.name: add_a_new_counterparty_record
prompts.title: Add a new counterparty record
prompts.description: The AI creates a counterparty (contact) record. It holds no bank details and moves no money.

prompts.name: read_ledgers_accounts_balances_and_entries
prompts.title: Read ledgers, accounts, balances and entries
prompts.description: The AI lists double-entry ledgers and ledger accounts, reads one account with balances, and lists individual debits and credits.
